title: 金平府守花灯
subtitle: 共享一盏光，也要先商量
origin: 《西游记》第九十一至九十二回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 有需要可以开口求助；未经同意拿走公共物品，会让更多人失去安全和快乐。
moral.en: It is always okay to ask for help. Taking shared resources without agreement can leave many others without safety or joy.

pages.zh: 金平府灯会亮如星河，三盏大花灯守着全城夜路。
pages.en: Jinping's lantern festival shone like a river of stars, with three great lanterns lighting the city's roads.
pages.prompt: Full team enters a warm ancient lantern festival with three huge flower-shaped lanterns lighting broad safe streets; no fireworks, no text in image.

pages.zh: 半夜，三盏花灯同时暗了。地上只留下三串圆圆的蹄印。
pages.en: At midnight, all three great lanterns went dark, leaving three trails of round hoofprints.
pages.prompt: Team and townspeople inspect three dim flower lanterns and three harmless round hoofprint trails under moonlight; calm mystery, no text in image.

pages.zh: 悟空顺着蹄印来到寒谷，看见三位犀牛兄弟正把灯油分给怕冷的小动物。
pages.en: Following the tracks, Wukong found three rhino brothers sharing lamp oil with cold animals in a valley.
pages.prompt: Three friendly rounded rhino brothers in blue, green, and amber vests pour glowing oil into covered warming lamps for small animals; Wukong observes, no text in image.

pages.zh: 他们说山谷太冷，只想借一点光，却没想到城里的夜路也需要灯。
pages.en: They said the valley was cold and they only wanted some light, not realizing the city roads needed it too.
pages.prompt: Rhino brothers explain beside warm animal shelters while Wukong shows a small model of dark city paths; sympathetic expressions, no text in image.

pages.zh: 唐僧请大家围成一圈：先说各自需要多少，再看看怎样公平分配。
pages.en: Tang Seng gathered everyone in a circle to share how much light they needed and plan a fair division.
pages.prompt: Tang Seng, team, rhino brothers, townspeople, and animals sit in a cooperative circle around three covered lamps; no written charts, no text in image.

pages.zh: 沙僧搭反光板，八戒做保温罩，白龙马把新灯油稳稳送进山谷。
pages.en: Sha built reflectors, Bajie made warm lamp covers, and White Dragon Horse carried fresh oil safely into the valley.
pages.prompt: Team builds safe rounded reflectors and insulated lamp covers while White Dragon Horse carries sealed oil jars; no open flames, no text in image.

pages.zh: 三兄弟把原来的灯油送回城，还主动轮流守护山谷和城里的夜灯。
pages.en: The brothers returned the city's oil and volunteered to take turns caring for both valley and city lights.
pages.prompt: Three rhino brothers return sealed oil jars beneath relit flower lanterns and receive simple caretaker lanterns; cheerful accountability, no text in image.

pages.zh: 灯会重新亮起。远处传来天竺国乐声，师徒知道下一段路又开始了。
pages.en: The festival glowed again. Music drifted from Tianzhu in the distance, and the travelers knew the next road was beginning.
pages.prompt: Full team leaves the glowing festival toward a distant elegant city silhouette while rhino brothers and townspeople wave; warm finale, no text in image.
